episodes.title: Construyendo a Nacho Vidal
episodes.summary: Valencia, 1993. For Ignacio Jordá, sex is his greatest obsession. But Nacho is done with being the black sheep of his family and wants to show he can do more than drift through life, even if that means "fucking" everyone.

episodes.title: Ser un héroe, esa es la cuestión
episodes.summary: Only a select few manage to achieve success in the world of sex. And Nacho wants to be one of the few. He and Sara have pure sexual chemistry, but performing in front of dozens of people is a whole other ball game. Will Nacho Vidal rise up at last?

episodes.title: Las hostias que más duelen
episodes.summary: A leading pioneer of Spanish porn cinema makes Nacho an offer. But first... he has to earn the role by auditioning against his biggest rival. However, accepting the challenge may mean losing his family when they find out - and disapprove.

episodes.title: El precio de ser el mejor
episodes.summary: Having established himself as a star and securing his family's approval, Nacho enjoys life as a porn star. But when the great Rocco Siffredi knocks on his door, Nacho faces a new challenge: having to adapt to the king of porn's very particular style.

episodes.title: 101 mujeres
episodes.summary: Nacho has taken a giant step and risks losing his place as Spain's next big thing. To succeed, he must face Rocco's challenge: a starring role, and 101 women! Nacho's delusions of grandeur, and temptation in the form of a woman, may jeopardize everything.

episodes.title: La gran liga, ¿really?
episodes.summary: Nacho has crossed the pond to conquer the American market. He moves in with his girlfriend, Bellisima, and begins to carve out his place. But it's not a given. Can Nacho cope with it all, or will the American dream eat him up?

episodes.title: Adicto, o algo así
episodes.summary: Nacho's insatiable ambition knows no bounds: he wants awards, he wants to direct... he wants it ALL. But the ghosts that haunt him and push him to live life to the max, also lead him to a series of mistakes. And, this time, there may be no coming back.

episodes.title: Volver a empezar
episodes.summary: The higher you climb, the harder you fall. Nacho's excesses have made him lose his way and hurt the people he loves most. It's time to get his life back on track: return to Barcelona, see his people, and fulfill promises he once made to old friends.
